title: Choose the check-in layout
question: All three use the Forest Light look and the same measures. Lock the layout to build, or add a note to borrow from another.

options.label: Last 28 days first
options.thesis: The check-in opens on what your readiness checks already say about the month, then asks for today's numbers below.
options.viewport: Monthly check-in and the date, a panel with average sleep and back, shoulder and neck pain from 22 readiness checks, then weight and waist side by side and resting heart rate.
options.risk: Today's fields start halfway down the first screen, under numbers you can't change.

options.label: Then and now
options.thesis: Every measure sits on one row with its Day 1 value beside today's field, so the change is plain as you type.
options.viewport: Column heads Day 1 · Sep 14 and Today, then rows for weight, waist, resting heart rate, blood pressure and push-ups, Day 1 in gray and today in large numerals.
options.risk: On Day 1 there is nothing to compare yet, and the fields are narrower.

options.label: Checklist
options.thesis: Each measure is one row that opens to its how-to and field, with a check once it's recorded; skipped rows stay quiet.
options.viewport: A line reading 3 needed, 7 optional, then weight and waist checked with their values, resting heart rate open with its how-to and field, and closed rows for the rest.
options.risk: Every measure takes a tap to open, and values stay out of sight until you look.
